description: Machine-readable contracts that Entity-aware agents must load or install instead of depending on private crew memory.

contracts.summary: Agents must send Entity FS docs links for workspace artifacts instead of raw local paths.
rules: Before sending a local artifact path, map it to a configured Entity File Source.
Use the docs URL format {entityBaseUrl}/docs/source/{sourceId}/{relativePath} as the primary user-facing link.
When available, call scripts/entity-fs-link.sh <path> or an equivalent resolver before replying.
If no source can read the file, report [not exposed in Entity FS] and fix or request a source mapping instead of presenting a local filesystem path as the deliverable.
verification: The generated docs link returns HTTP 200.

contracts.summary: Entity-aware agents need a source registry that maps local roots to Entity File Source ids.
rules: Installers must configure the local workspace and known crew workspaces as Entity File Sources where access is available.
Verification must check source health before claiming document delivery is ready.
Do not hard-code a single machine path as the Entity filesystem model.

contracts.summary: Entity code changes happen in the canonical Mac repo and are deployed through the normal pipeline.
rules: Treat the Mac checkout at ~/Code/entity as the canonical Entity source of truth unless a newer project context overrides it.
Use a clean worktree for changes when the canonical checkout is dirty.
Push changes to Entity GitHub before reporting code delivery complete.
For live user-visible changes, verify the live Entity URL/API/browser path before claiming production state.

contracts.summary: Entity work must be tracked with plans, review state, and evidence.
rules: Tasks longer than a few minutes belong in Mission Control before substantial work starts.
Any task with more than two steps needs a dated plan and ACTIVE_PLAN pointer.
Finished work must move to review with an accessible output/evidence link before being reported complete.
Evidence links should use Entity FS docs links where possible.

contracts.summary: OpenClaw config mutations must use schema-aware paths and first-class tooling.
rules: Use config.schema.lookup before config changes when available.
Use config.patch or a first-class command/tool instead of hand-editing OpenClaw runtime config files.
After gateway/plugin changes, verify restart/load state and inspect startup errors before reporting success.
